metaDescription: Lykoi vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Lykoi boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Lykois: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Lykoi series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class medium does not invent new viruses for the Lykoi, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final FVRCP booster.
Flag limited long-term dataset at Lykoi vaccine checkups so the kitten’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Lykoi series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Lykoi misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Lykoi series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Lykoi is the gap, not the embarrassment, because panleukopenia pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated kitten even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up FVRCP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Lykoi away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Lykoi due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Lykoi core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Lykoi misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Lykoi health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Lykoi adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
